caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden mask of an animal face, resembling a feline or possibly a stylized lion, depicted in a three-quarter view against a plain, light beige background. The mask has two prominent pointed ears at the top and two almond-shaped eyes, each with a small round pupil. The wood is illustrated with varying shades of brown, accented by light gray and blue tones to indicate texture, grain, and weathering. There are visible cracks, notches, and irregular surface details across the mask, as well as several circular marks that look like nails or tacks embedded in the wood. The mask's lower sides show layered, feather-like extensions, suggesting fur or a mane, carved in a stylized, undulating pattern. On the bottom right of the page, there is handwriting indicating "Fig 344 Page 155 HARRY KING K.C. MO."
title: Bobcat
